Action.description:
A form that is the whole right-hand side of its own statement
(`K-STMT-001`).

oneOf.description: Calls a function and yields what it returns.
Runs one effect and yields its result, decoded as `result`.
Waits for a number of milliseconds.
Waits on one task handle.
Waits on a list of task handles.
Lets every other ready task run first.
Starts a task running a function and yields its handle.
Raises a cancellation in a task at its current wait.

Atom.description: An argument of an action: a variable or a literal, never a computation.

Callee.description: What a statement-position call or a `spawn` runs.

oneOf.description: A declared function of the document, by name.
The closure or function reference a variable holds.
A library function, by identity.

binding.description: The variable the caught error value is bound to.

Closure.description:
A function value written in place. It shares the variables of the scope
that defines it (`K-CLO-001`); which ones is derived, never written.

Edit.description: One typed change to a document or to its annotations.

oneOf.description: Removes a statement and everything under it.

Moves a statement and everything under it. Every node moved
survives.

Copies a statement and everything under it, annotations included.
The copy is new: no node of it corresponds to a node of the base.

Replaces a whole statement. The statement survives; what was under
it does not.

Replaces an expression, at any depth. The expression survives; what
was under it does not.

Replaces an action: the right-hand side that calls, performs, waits,
spawns or cancels.

Replaces one argument of an action, counted from 0 in the order the
action writes them. A `sleep`, `join`, `join` of a list and `cancel`
have the one argument.
Replaces the condition of an `if` or a `while`.

Sets or clears the `catch` of a `try`. The `try`, its body and its
`finally` survive.

Sets or clears the `finally` of a `try`. The `try`, its body and its
`catch` survive.

Renames a variable where it is declared and in every use that
resolves to that declaration.

`declared_at` is the node that declares it: the `let`, the `for`,
the `try` of its `catch`, the closure expression, or a declared
function's body for one of its parameters.
Sets or clears a node's label.
Sets or clears one entry of what a host keeps on a node.
Removes a declared function, and its entry when it has one.

Replaces a declared function's parameters and body. Its body block
survives; what was under it does not.

Renames a declared function in its declaration, its entry and every
call, spawn and reference of it.

Sets which of `main`'s top-level variables are the program's own
(`K-SES-001`).
Makes a declared function one a host may start, under `signature`.

Makes a declared function no longer one a host may start. The
function stays.
[`Edit::RenameFunction`] of a function that is an entry.
Sets the signature the document expects of an effect it performs.
Sets how an effect result's bare number decodes (`K-EFF-006`).

Adopts a corrected library function: every call of `from` in the
document becomes a call of `to` (`K-VER-002`).

Expr.description: An expression: evaluated within one statement, it never pauses a task.

oneOf.description: Reads a field or an index.
Calls a library function that has a native implementation.
The embedder's clock, as a timestamp.
A float drawn by the embedder, uniform in `[0, 1)`.
Reads through a projection handle.

Function.description: A declared function's parameters and body.

oneOf.description: Every member has ended, or the first failure.
Every member has ended.
The first member to end.
The first member to succeed.
A reference to a declared function of the document.

Member.description: A field of a record or an index into a collection.

Name.description:
A variable, parameter or declared-function name.

Any text is a name; the kernel gives none of them meaning. Structural
validation refuses the empty name.

NumberPolicy.description:
How a document's effect results decode a number whose type says only
"number" (`K-EFF-006`).

oneOf.description: Every bare number is a float.

A number written with no fraction and no exponent is an integer; any
other is a float.

optional.description:
The argument may be omitted, and is then absent (`K-FN-004`). No
required parameter follows an optional one.

Position.description:
Where a statement is put: in `block`, ahead of the statement `before`,
or at the block's end.

request.description: What is asked of the projection: kernel data the host interprets.

rest.description:
The type of every field not named in `fields`. `None` closes the
record: it has no other field.

Rhs.description: The right-hand side of a `let` or an assignment.

Signature.description: What a function, an effect or an entry takes and returns.

Site.description:
A node's address: the code it belongs to and the chain of
[`Node::children`] indexes that reaches it from that code's body.

A site is derived from the document and is never written by a host
(`K-ID-004`). An empty chain addresses the body itself.

oneOf.description: Declares a variable in the enclosing block and gives it a value.
Writes a variable, a field or an index.

Removes a field of a record, an element of a list, an entry of a map
or a member of a set.
Runs an action and discards its result.

Runs `body` once per element of a collection, binding each to
`binding`.
Ends the run with a result.
Ends the run as failed, with a reason.
Every value.

An integer or a float. In an effect's result this is the bare number
the document's number policy decodes (`K-EFF-006`).
A tuple of exactly these member types.
A text that is one of these.
A closure or a function reference that takes and returns these.
A task handle whose task ends with this.
A handle of this host kind.
A value of any one of these types. Two or more, none itself a union.

Unit.description: The code a node belongs to.

oneOf.description: The document's `main`.
A declared function of the document.
The kernel-code body of a library function.

description: A set of edits applied whole or not at all (`K-EDIT-001`).

base.description:
The identity of the document the edits were written against. Every
site in `edits` is a site of that document.

title: Transaction
